A timed-out approval request may or may not have durably recorded the approval, leaving an ambiguous/partial persisted state that no observer can trust.

Approval state may not survive an api process restart, violating the promise that persisted state survives a re-read.

unresolved_questions: Neither acceptance criterion states who is authorized to approve an invoice, so authorization/cross_tenant scenarios cannot be grounded — confirm whether approval must be access-controlled before verifying it.

The ACs do not define the required response shape or status code for a successful approval beyond 'records durably'; the 200 expectations above are assumed and should be confirmed against the intended contract.

No approved command resets persisted approval state, so scenarios rely on unique invoice ids for isolation rather than teardown — confirm whether a reset/cleanup mechanism should exist for the durable store.
